Zoe CSM: Quick help — CareBridge goes live in 6h. Finance saw demo p99 spikes. Can we send a 1-page customer-facing checklist (prefill, batching, streaming fallback, tiny CSV for renewal metrics)? 

Cam CS-Ops: Yup. I'll make it copy/paste and add an internal 3-step checklist.

Eli SRE: What model/targets?

Zoe CSM: 7B-q4, goal p95 <350ms p99 <1s.

Rita Eng: Draft customer one-liner runbook:
1) Warm Pools: Settings -> Performance -> Warm Pools = ON.
2) Prefill: prefill.intents = [greet,search,summary]; cadence = 30m.
3) Client batching: client_window_ms=25 (+/-10ms jitter), max_batch=40. Alt: window=10ms max_batch=24 for spiky UX.
4) Streaming guardrail: stream_threshold_ms=750 -> fallback_model="7B-lite".
5) Telemetry CSV: timestamp,route,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens,requests,error_rate (send T-24h and T+48h).

Cam CS-Ops: Internal CS post-deploy: run 6 prefills, confirm warm slots active, verify p95<p350ms or escalate.

deploy-bot: scheduled warmup job for tenant carebridge at 2026-03-28T03:30:00Z (3 slots) created by Cam CS-Ops
